company_name.description: Official company name as a clean proper noun, with no qualifiers or parentheticals. If the content does not state it explicitly, infer it from the page title or the domain in the URL. Never 'unknown', empty, or a placeholder.

industry.description: Primary industry (be specific, e.g. 'B2B SaaS - HR Technology' not just 'Software')

industry_sector.description: Broader sector (Technology, Healthcare, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Retail, Real Estate, Media, Professional Services, Energy, Transportation, etc.)

business_model.description: How they make money, grounded in the website content (e.g. SaaS, marketplace, professional services, manufacturing, financial services, debt settlement). This is an existing FACT — if the content gives no clear signal, return exactly "unknown" rather than guessing.

description.description: 2-3 sentence description of what they do

company_size.description: Estimated employee-count band, grounded in the content. Use exactly one of the allowed values; return "unknown" if the content gives no size signal.

revenue_model.description: How revenue is actually charged, grounded in the content (e.g. subscription, transaction fee, success fee, professional services). This is an existing FACT — return exactly "unknown" if the content gives no clear signal rather than guessing.

tech_signals.description: Technology signals from job postings, tech stack mentions, integrations

ai_maturity.description: Current AI adoption level (None evident, Early exploration, Partial adoption, AI-forward)

key_risks_visible.description: Obvious risk signals visible on the site
